title: Fold a hand-written Display into thiserror
summary: Replace impl Display, impl Error and From with derive(Error), then stop printing the cause twice.

turns.user: the impls in store.rs are way too long. we already have thiserror, use that

assistant.body: Sure! Display becomes #[error("...")], and source plus From fold into a single #[from]. The boilerplate goes away and the error type is the single source of truth for its own messages. load keeps working unchanged.

turns.user: logged it with anyhow {:#} and No such file or directory shows up twice

assistant.body: Good catch. #[from] also makes the io::Error the source, so anyhow appends the cause after the message on its own. The {0} was copied over from the hand-written version, and it printed the cause a second time. Dropping it from the message.
sed -i '' 's/cannot read store: {0}/cannot read store/' src/store.rs
